events.title: 2026 Strait of Hormuz Crisis / Iran War
events.description: Strait of Hormuz effectively closed since Feb 2026. Trump wants to declare it US territory. Houthi threats to Bahrain/UAE. Iran seeking fees on passing ships.

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic (DRC/Uganda) - PHEIC declared
events.description: Bundibugyo ebolavirus. 4665 cases, 2184 deaths (46.8% CFR). Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. WHO PHEIC declared May 17 2026.

events.title: US-Japan Joint Currency Intervention - Largest in 15 Years
events.description: Japan sold ~, US contributed -10B. Yen already erased half the gains, approaching 160 again. Treasury doubling down on bond buybacks.

events.title: China Property Crisis Escalation - .6T Fund Mobilized
events.description: China widens use of .6 trillion fund to spur home spending. July bank loans post record contraction. Crisis spreading to commercial real estate.

events.title: Global Food Crisis Convergence
events.description: Hormuz disruption hitting fertilizer/food trade. European drought. Ukraine ports closed since July 2026. US cattle herd smallest since 1950s. JPMorgan warns of food crisis.

events.title: US Treasury Verbal Intervention on Bond Market
events.description: Treasury doubling down on buybacks to steady bond market. Fed at 3.50-3.75% with 30% probability of hike.
